description: The file defines the ConceptDatatype class in the package org.openmrs, which models a concept datatype within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes constants for various datatype UUIDs, HL7 abbreviations, and methods for checking datatype properties.

classes.name: ConceptDatatype
classes.description: Represents a concept data type in OpenMRS, including properties for defining datatype attributes and methods for identifying specific data types.

methods.name: getConceptDatatypeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this concept datatype.

methods.name: setConceptDatatypeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this concept datatype.

methods.name: getHl7Abbreviation
methods.description: Retrieves the HL7 abbreviation for this datatype.

methods.name: setHl7Abbreviation
methods.description: Sets the HL7 abbreviation for this datatype.

methods.name: isAnswerOnly
methods.description: Checks if the datatype represents an answer-only concept (not a question), based on UUID.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is numeric, based on UUID.

methods.name: isCoded
methods.description: Determines if the datatype is coded (i.e., refers to an external vocabulary).

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Checks if the datatype represents a date.

methods.name: isTime
methods.description: Checks if the datatype represents time.

methods.name: isDateTime
methods.description: Checks if the datatype represents a date and time.

methods.name: containsDate
methods.description: Checks if the datatype contains date-related information.

methods.name: containsTime
methods.description: Checks if the datatype contains time-related information.

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Determines if the datatype is text-based.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Determines if the datatype is boolean.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier (id) of this datatype.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier (id) of this datatype.

methods.name: isComplex
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is complex, based on UUID.

methods.name: isRule
methods.description: Checks if the datatype is a rule, based on UUID.
